problem: The text says “The SSE after the first iteration is 30 (see the figure).” The calculated sum of squared errors after the first iteration (using the new centroids (3, 2.5) and (6.25, 6.5)) is 78.75, not 30. The figure shows SSE = 30 after the third iteration, not after the first.
fix: Replace the sentence with something like: “The SSE after the first iteration is 78.75. After three iterations the SSE drops to 30, as shown in the figure.”

problem: The formula is written as Σ ‖xᵢ‑cⱼ‖² without specifying the summation index. This can be confusing because the sum should be over each data point i to its assigned centroid c_{a(i)}.
fix: Rewrite the definition as Σᵢ ‖xᵢ‑c_{a(i)}‖², where a(i) is the index of the centroid assigned to point i.
